title: Isolated partial tear of subscapularis muscle in a competitive water skier. A case report.
journal: The Journal of sports medicine and physical fitness

sections.label: UNLABELED
sections.text: Partial tears of the subscapularis tendon associated with anterior shoulder dislocation, are frequently described while the isolated lesions of this tendon are quite rare. We report the case of a 33 years old water-skier who injured his right subscapularis muscle during a forced movement of adduction and internal rotation. Ultrasound evaluation and then MRI were used to depict the entity of the lesion. The ruptured tendon was surgically repaired using a MITEK anchor system. Four months after surgery, the athlete returned back to his full athletic activity.
